# Sugar Defender (sugardefender.onrender.com)

> sugardefender.onrender.com is an independent reader information site about Sugar Defender, a liquid-drop dietary supplement. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's page and supplied photos)
- Format: liquid drops in a dropper bottle; seller's directions: two full droppers in the morning before breakfast, held under the tongue for 30 seconds, or mixed into water; a bottle is listed as a 30-day supply
- Named ingredients: eleuthero, coleus, maca root, African mango, guarana, gymnema, ginseng, chromium; no amounts given
- The seller calls it "stimulant-free" although guarana is a natural source of caffeine
- Packs: 2 bottles $69 each ($138 plus shipping), 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free US shipping), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping); listed as 60, 90 and 180 days
- 60-day money-back guarantee; product including empty bottles can be returned; refund minus shipping and handling, issued within 48 hours of receipt (seller's statement)
- Not a treatment for diabetes or any disease; gymnema, chromium and ginseng can lower blood sugar further in people on diabetes medicine
